description: EXPLORATORY (Q-35): where P-14's and P-16's routed funded openings fall in U1's replay (every start, both arms, every response off): the marks, hours (CT), entry delays, the shares inside 08:30-09:00 CT and on BLS report days, FOMC days, the early-close calendar's kinds, weekdays, years and stops, on the choice block, the judged block and both. A supply count: no outcome.

notes.no_outcome: no P&L, win, loss, exit, pass or payout is written or printed
notes.status: EXPLORATORY (Q-35, E-021 (2)): where P-14's and P-16's routed funded openings fall in U1's replay -- a supply count, no outcome; beside the registered verdicts, selects nothing
notes.variant_count_rule: one reading a design and arm; exploratory, no family

counted.distinct_trades: the distinct historical trades (date, index in the day) among them
counted.openings: each start's funded accounts' openings (the same historical trade opens accounts in many starts' replays)

parameters.entry: entry_t - 1: the open of the entry bar, whose END index on the clock is entry_t
parameters.mark: decision_slot_minutes, minutes after 17:00 CT (the trading-day clock), as HH:MM CT
parameters.opening: a funded account's first executed trade in the engine's ledger, first by (day, slot) -- U2's opening_trade (vendor/stage2/scripts/u_xfa_day_budget.py)
parameters.replay: U1's (vendor/stage2/scripts/user_journey.py) as Q-17 adapted it (extended.user_beside): each start's long run of min(252, sessions left) sessions, every response off (ConductModel(rtp=False, enforcement_p=0.0)), the engine's per-trade ledger on (record_trades=True), nothing else changed

seeds.draws: none: an as-happened replay (SharedDayDraws(replay=True)) draws no day
seeds.path_seed: lockstep.child_seed(20261920, 0, start_day) (extended.user_beside.start_seed): feeds only the enforcement stream, unused at 0 %

parameters.session: dates[start + historical_day] (ReplayTable: calendar day = historical day + 1, checked); a trading day runs 17:00 CT the evening before to 15:10 CT
parameters.starts: every start of each design's development window

provenance.read_ledger: 1 line(s) appended to results/read_ledger.jsonl by this run, each a ledger record: recorded as its own writes (D-207)
